inputs.original_text: Former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader Job Sikhala has called for the rejection of proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030. Addressing members of the media at a press conference, Sikhala criticised what he described as [...] The post Sikhala Takes Aim at Constitutional Amendment Bill 3 appeared first on 263Chat .
inputs.modified_text: Job Sikhala, the former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader, is demanding the outright rejection of the proposed constitutional amendments intended to extend President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term until 2030. He took this stand at a press conference, denouncing the Constitutional Amendment Bill 3 as an unacceptable move by those in power. This is clearly a structural ploy by the elites to lock in their power and block any real advancement toward equality. Such actions will only intensify the historical inequalities that have oppressed working people and vulnerable groups for years. We need to reject this without hesitation and fight for institutional reforms centered on social justice, labor rights, and the protection of the marginalized, rather than safeguarding the power of the elite.
